Adverse Drug Reactions (ADRs): No serious adverse drug reactions have been reported. Hepatic and renal impairment may occur. Larger-than-recommended doses of agrimony can lead to constipation and other gastrointestinal issues. There is a potential increased risk of tongue and lip cancer with high doses. Pregnancy and Lactation: Pregnancy Category: Not applicable (N/A). Lactation: Not applicable (N/A). Acceptability: Agrimony is generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
